notes: EXAMPLE, VERIFY BEFORE USE. The rules follow the eligibility and exclusion list given by the project owner (Session 3 brief), NOT text read from the official page: pmkisan.gov.in was blocked (HTTP 403) from the build environment.
Check the amount, the instalments and every exclusion against https://pmkisan.gov.in/ before setting verified_at.

Eligible = at least one household member owns cultivable land. Each exclusion is its own rule, written as 'no member of the household ...', so the result page can show which one applies and who triggered it.

Pension rule: a pension of Rs 10,000 a month or more excludes the person unless they were Group D / Multi Tasking Staff. Serving or retired employees other than Group D are excluded whatever their pension.
not_encoded: Institutional landholders: no member field for this.

The scheme's 'family' is husband, wife and minor children. This file checks the WHOLE household, so in a joint family an adult relative's exclusion (for example income tax paid by an uncle) can wrongly exclude the family. To fix once members can be linked as spouse/child: use 'among': 'applicant_family' on the any_member rules.
Any cut-off date or other condition on land ownership in the official guidelines.
Registration and e-KYC steps on the PM-KISAN portal.

version.benefit_text_en: Example, verify before use: income support of Rs 6,000 a year for farmer families that own cultivable land, paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000 straight into the bank account. Families with an excluded member (for example an income tax payer or a government employee other than Group D) do not qualify.
version.benefit_text_hi: उदाहरण, उपयोग से पहले जाँचें: खेती योग्य भूमि वाले किसान परिवारों को साल में 6,000 रुपये की सहायता, 2,000 रुपये की तीन किस्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते में। जिस परिवार में कोई बाहर रखा गया सदस्य है (जैसे आयकर देने वाला या ग्रुप डी के अलावा सरकारी कर्मचारी) उसे लाभ नहीं मिलता।
